name: bifrost-plugin
description: Bifrost MCP gateway plugin for Claude Code and Claude Desktop: skill discovery, agent-driven memory, one-command onboarding, signed admin policy, and opt-in browser sign-in.

gateway_url.title: Bifrost gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Your gateway's MCP endpoint, including the /mcp path. Keep the default unless your operator gave you a different gateway.

virtual_key.title: Virtual key (optional)
virtual_key.description: Get yours at https://bifrost.culture4.life/ — sign in with your company account and the page shows your key with a copy button. First visit creates it, later visits show the same one. Paste it here.

auto_login.title: Sign in automatically
auto_login.description: When no virtual key is set, open your browser once at startup for company sign-in and fetch your key automatically. The key is cached on this machine only.

keyapp_url.title: Key page URL (optional)
keyapp_url.description: Where sign-in fetches your key. Leave empty to use the gateway's own host.

migrate_legacy.title: Clean up older Bifrost setups
migrate_legacy.description: Once a day, move the key of a hand-added bifrost MCP server for this gateway into the plugin and remove that server, which otherwise hides the plugin's own. Off by default.
